claims.source_checked: Lobanov, Chicherov & Sharov, Arktika i Sever 44:267-284 (2021), doi:10.37482/issn2221-2698.2021.44.267; English full text https://arcticandnorth.ru/upload/iblock/61f/44_224_239.pdf and Russian full text https://arcticandnorth.ru/upload/iblock/df4/267_284.pdf
claims.note: 27 Sept 1984 = 1984.74. Lobanov: string broke that day 'at a depth of more than 12 km' after 9 m more; the second shaft 'reached 12066 m'; branch 'started at a depth of 7010 m'. Lobanov also says 12,066 m was reached in 1983, so the dashed join 12.0 (end 1983) to 12.066 (Sept 1984) is not a dated reading; the difference (66 m) is under 4 px on this chart, and the code says the joins only connect readings. claims.claim: Chart: line from the restart to 12.262 km at 1990, then a flat 12.262 km bar from 1990 to 1991
claims.source_checked: Lobanov, Chicherov & Sharov, Arktika i Sever 44:267-284 (2021), doi:10.37482/issn2221-2698.2021.44.267: English full text https://arcticandnorth.ru/upload/iblock/61f/44_224_239.pdf (pp. 230-233, text and Fig. 5b on p. 232) and Russian full text https://arcticandnorth.ru/upload/iblock/df4/267_284.pdf; Zhu & Huang, Commun. Earth Environ. 7:124 (2026), doi:10.1038/s43247-026-03246-z (nature.com full text and reference list); src/shorts/deepest-hole-long/index.tsx lines 160-335
claims.note: Depth and end date are right: Lobanov 'In 1990, the maximum depth was reached - 12262 m'; Fig. 5b labels the branch end 1990; 'As of 05/01/1991, the well depth was 12262 m' (Russian: 'По состоянию на 01.05.1991', i.e. 1 May 1991), so 12.262 km at 1991.0 is supported. Zhu & Huang's 'reaching 12,262 m between 1970 and 1989' cites Lobanov itself (their ref. 29), so it misreads the chart's own source. The problem is where in the year the arrival is drawn. The chart plots dated events at decimal dates (27 Dec 1983 = 1983.99, 27 Sep 1984 = 1984.74, restart 1985.33), so the line ending at X(1990) and the bar starting there say 12,262 m was reached by 1 Jan 1990 and held all through 1990. Lobanov gives only the year, and also says 'After the largest accident in 1984, it took 6 years to reach 12 km depth again' (Sep 1984 + 6 yr = about late 1990), so early 1990 at 12,262 m is the 1989 reading, not the narrower one both sources support (A3). Fix: end the line at [1991, FINAL_KM] ('by the end of 1990', true on either reading) and draw the bar from X(1991) to X(1991.33) (1 May 1991); or keep the drawing and put the arrival point mid-1990 or later with the chart saying the date within 1990 is not known. SOURCES item 9 records the 1989/1990 disagreement but should add that Zhu & Huang cite Lobanov for it, and should cite the 1 May 1991 depth and the chart's arrival date, which the drawing rests on (A1, A6).
